refnamediv.refpurpose: Wait until reading or writing is possible for any cURL multi handle connection

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
intcurl_multi_select CurlMultiHandlemulti_handle floattimeout1.0
Blocks the execution of the script until a cURL handle attached to the cURL multi handle would be able to make progress on the next call to curl_multi_exec or until the timeout strikes (whichever comes first).
The function returns immediately, without waiting for the timeout, when libcurl has no file descriptor to wait on, for example with an empty multi handle. A loop around curl_multi_exec must not rely on this function alone to pause, or it may consume CPU in a busy loop.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
On success, returns the number of active descriptors contained in the descriptor sets. This may be 0 if there was no activity on any of the descriptors. On failure, this function will return -1 on a select failure (from the underlying select() system call), or when it is called from a callback of one of the handles of multi_handle while a transfer is running; curl_multi_errno then returns 8 (CURLM_RECURSIVE_API_CALL).
